title: Inject the runner identity at the socket boundary

epic.name: Async test suite through dependency injection

story.i_want_to: give the socket the runner I inserted
story.so_that: the test need not commit one

rationale: Loopctl.Runners.authenticate_identified (RunnerSocket.connect) resolves the runner on another repo connection than the test writes on.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every converted module is `async: true`; the commit gate passes; production behaviour is unchanged (the injected input defaults to the value the code read before).

The real Runners.authenticate_identified read runs against the test's own sandbox connection (AdminRepo routed onto Repo in test); no resolver is injected, since the resolved runner is caller identity.
Tests whose subject is a committed lock holder move to a sync module of their own, with the reason stated.
